# Look at a few case studies...

# Look at top 20 mesh terms, see which are msot popular, then look at level 3 for those terms.


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(countrycode)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(plotly)
library(scales)
library(shiny)


knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  fig.width = 6,
  fig.asp = .6,
  out.width = "90%"
)

theme_set(theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "bottom"))

options(
  ggplot2.continuous.colour = "viridis",
  ggplot2.continuous.fill = "viridis"

scale_colour_discrete = scale_colour_viridis_d
scale_fill_discrete = scale_fill_viridis_d
```

Number of unique studies per country

```{r}
studies_by_country = countries |>
  semi_join(studies, by = "nct_id") |>
  group_by(country) |>
  summarise(
    n_studies = n_distinct(nct_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(n_studies))

# View top 20 countries
studies_by_country |>
  slice_head(n = 20)
```

Countries With the Most Registered Clinical Studies

```{r}
studies_by_country |>
  slice_max(n_studies, n = 20) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = n_studies,
    y = reorder(country, n_studies)
  )) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Countries With the Most Registered Clinical Studies",
    subtitle = "ClinicalTrials.gov / AACT",
    x = "Number of unique registered studies",
    y = "Country"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

Registered Clinical Studies by Country and Study Type

```{r}
studies_by_country_type = countries |>
  inner_join(
    studies |>
      select(nct_id, study_type),
    by = "nct_id"
  ) |>
  group_by(country, study_type) |>
  summarise(
    n_studies = n_distinct(nct_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Identify top 20 countries overall
top_countries = studies_by_country |>
  slice_max(n_studies, n = 20) |>
  pull(country)

# Stacked bar chart
studies_by_country_type |>
  filter(country %in% top_countries) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = n_studies,
    y = forcats::fct_reorder(
      country, n_studies, .fun = sum
    ),
    fill = study_type
  )) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Registered Clinical Studies by Country and Study Type",
    x = "Number of registered studies",
    y = "Country",
    fill = "Study Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}

# Count studies initiated between 2015 and 2025
studies_by_country = countries |>
  inner_join(
    studies |>
      mutate(year = year(start_date)) |>
      filter(between(year, 2015, 2025)) |>
      select(nct_id),
    by = "nct_id"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    country_iso3 = countrycode(
      country,
      origin = "country.name",
      destination = "iso3c"
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(country_iso3)) |>
  group_by(country_iso3) |>
  summarize(
    n_studies = n_distinct(nct_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```

```{r}

# Import country boundaries
world = ne_countries(
```

```{r}

map_year = 2023

# Clean country names in AACT
countries_clean = countries |>
  mutate(
    country_iso3 = countrycode(
      country,
      origin = "country.name",
      destination = "iso3c"
    ),
    country_iso3 = if_else(
      country == "Serbia and Montenegro",
      NA_character_,
      country_iso3
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(country_iso3)) |>
  distinct(nct_id, country, country_iso3)

# Count unique studies in the selected year
trial_counts = trials_df |>
  filter(start_year == map_year) |>
  select(nct_id) |>
  inner_join(countries_clean, by = "nct_id") |>
  group_by(country, country_iso3) |>
  summarise(
    n_trials = n_distinct(nct_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Pull one population value per country for the selected year
pop_df = daly_df |>
  filter(year == map_year) |>
  distinct(country, pop_thousands) |>
  mutate(
    country_iso3 = countrycode(
      country,
      origin = "country.name",
      destination = "iso3c"
    ),
    country_iso3 = if_else(
      country == "Serbia and Montenegro",
      NA_character_,
      country_iso3
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(country_iso3), !is.na(pop_thousands), pop_thousands > 0)

# Merge trial counts with population
trial_density = trial_counts |>
  inner_join(
    pop_df |>
      select(country_iso3, pop_thousands),
    by = "country_iso3"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    studies_per_million = n_trials / pop_thousands * 1000
  )

trial_density |>
  arrange(desc(studies_per_million)) |>
  slice_head(n = 20)
```

```{r}
plot_ly(
  data = trial_density,
  type = "choropleth",
  locations = ~country_iso3,
  locationmode = "ISO-3",
  z = ~studies_per_million,
  text = ~paste0(
    country,
    "<br>Trials: ", comma(n_trials),
    "<br>Population (thousands): ", comma(pop_thousands),
    "<br>Trials per million: ", round(studies_per_million, 2)
  ),
  hoverinfo = "text",
  colorscale = "Viridis"
) |>
  layout(
    title = paste(
      "Registered Clinical Studies per Million Population,",
      map_year
    ),
    geo = list(
      showframe = FALSE,
      showcoastlines = FALSE,
      projection = list(type = "natural earth")
    )
  )
```

# Investigate whether the proportion of registered observational versus interventional studies varies across countries

```{r}

study_types_country = studies |>
  select(nct_id, study_type) |>
  filter(
    study_type %in% c("INTERVENTIONAL", "OBSERVATIONAL")
  ) |>
  distinct() |>
  inner_join(
    countries |> distinct(nct_id, country),
    by = "nct_id"
  ) |>
  count(country, study_type, name = "n_studies") |>
  group_by(country) |>
  mutate(
    total_studies = sum(n_studies),
    proportion = n_studies / total_studies
  ) |>
  ungroup()

study_types_country


# Identify the 80 countries with the most studies
top_countries = study_types_country |>
  distinct(country, total_studies) |>
  slice_max(total_studies, n = 80) |>
  pull(country)

study_types_country |>
  filter(country %in% top_countries) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = proportion,
    y = forcats::fct_reorder(country, total_studies),
    fill = study_type
  )) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Clinical Study Types by Country",
    subtitle = "Top 80 countries by registered study count",
    x = "Percentage of registered studies",
    y = "Country",
    fill = "Study Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

Combine country information with broad MeSH categories


```{r}

# One row per study-country
study_country = studies |>
  select(nct_id) |>
  inner_join(countries, by = "nct_id") |>
  distinct(nct_id, country)

# One row per study-disease category
study_disease = browse_conditions |>
  filter(mesh_term_condition %in% top_level_dz) |>
  transmute(
    nct_id,
    disease_category = mesh_term_condition
  ) |>
  distinct()

# Combine countries and diseases
study_country_disease = study_country |>
  inner_join(
    study_disease,
    by = "nct_id",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  )

# Calculate denominators for each country
country_totals = study_country |>
  count(country, name = "n_total")

country_classified = study_country_disease |>
  distinct(nct_id, country) |>
  count(country, name = "n_classified")

# Count studies investigating each disease in each country
country_disease = study_country_disease |>
  count(country, disease_category, name = "n_studies") |>
  left_join(country_totals, by = "country") |>
  left_join(country_classified, by = "country") |>
  mutate(
    pct_studies = 100 * n_studies / n_total,
    pct_classified = 100 * n_studies / n_classified
  )

```

## Which diseases are studied most in each country?

```{r}

top_diseases_by_country = country_disease |>
  group_by(country) |>
  slice_max(n_studies, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  arrange(country, desc(n_studies)) |>
  ungroup()

top_diseases_by_country |>
  select(country, disease_category, n_studies, pct_studies)


# Top 20 countries by overall number of studies
top_20_countries = country_totals |>
  slice_max(n_total, n = 20, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  pull(country)

# Top 10 disease categories globally
top_10_diseases = study_disease |>
  count(disease_category, sort = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  pull(disease_category)

# Prepare heatmap
heatmap_df = country_disease |>
  filter(
    country %in% top_20_countries,
    disease_category %in% top_10_diseases
  )

# Plot
heatmap_df |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = disease_category,
    y = forcats::fct_reorder(country, n_total),
    fill = pct_studies
  )) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    name = "% of studies"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Disease-Specific Clinical Research Across Countries",
    subtitle = "Top 20 countries and 10 most common disease categories",
    x = "Disease category",
    y = "Country"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )

```

# Interactive map!!!

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(countrycode)
library(shiny)
library(plotly)
library(DT)

# =====================================================
# 1. PREPARE MAP AND DISEASE DATA
# =====================================================

years_keep = 2019:2023

selected_studies = trials_df |>
  filter(start_year %in% years_keep) |>
  distinct(nct_id)

# One row per study-country
trial_countries = countries |>
  mutate(
    country_iso3 = countrycode(
      country, "country.name", "iso3c"
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(country_iso3)) |>
  distinct(nct_id, country_iso3)

study_country_map = selected_studies |>
  inner_join(trial_countries, by = "nct_id") |>
  distinct(nct_id, country_iso3)

# Count unique studies by country
country_counts = study_country_map |>
  group_by(country_iso3) |>
  summarise(
    n_studies = n_distinct(nct_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# WHO population for 2023
population = daly_df |>
  filter(year == 2023) |>
  mutate(
    country_iso3 = countrycode(
      country, "country.name", "iso3c"
    )
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(country_iso3),
    !is.na(pop_thousands),
    pop_thousands > 0
  ) |>
  distinct(country_iso3, pop_thousands)

# Confirm one population per country
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(population$country_iso3))

# Map data: annual studies per million residents
map_df = country_counts |>
  inner_join(population, by = "country_iso3") |>
  mutate(
    density = n_studies /
      length(years_keep) / pop_thousands * 1000,
    country_name = countrycode(
      country_iso3, "iso3c", "country.name"
    )
  )

# Broad disease classifications
study_diseases = browse_conditions |>
  filter(mesh_term_condition %in% top_level_dz) |>
  transmute(
    nct_id,
    disease_category = mesh_term_condition
  ) |>
  distinct()

# Disease-specific counts and proportions
country_diseases = study_country_map |>
  inner_join(
    study_diseases,
    by = "nct_id",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) |>
  distinct(nct_id, country_iso3, disease_category) |>
  count(
    country_iso3,
    disease_category,
    name = "n_category"
  ) |>
  left_join(country_counts, by = "country_iso3") |>
  mutate(
    pct_studies = 100 * n_category / n_studies
  )


# =====================================================
# 2. USER INTERFACE
# =====================================================

ui = fluidPage(

  titlePanel("Global Clinical Research Explorer"),

  fluidRow(

    column(
      7,
      h4("Registered studies per million residents"),
      plotlyOutput("world_map", height = "600px")
    ),

    column(
      5,
      h4(textOutput("country_title")),
      plotlyOutput("disease_plot", height = "650px")
    )

  ),

  hr(),

  fluidRow(
    column(
      12,
      h4(textOutput("studies_heading")),
      DTOutput("studies_table"),
      br(),
      p(
        "Dates describe the overall registered study,",
        "not necessarily its activities within the",
        "selected country. Completion dates may be",
        "actual or estimated."
      )
    )
  )

)


# =====================================================
# 3. SERVER
# =====================================================

server = function(input, output, session) {

  # Default to USA, if available
  default_country = if (
    "USA" %in% map_df$country_iso3
  ) {
    "USA"
  } else {
    map_df$country_iso3[1]
  }

  selected_country = reactiveVal(default_country)
  selected_disease = reactiveVal(NULL)


  # ---------------------------------------------------
  # A. INTERACTIVE WORLD MAP
  # ---------------------------------------------------

  output$world_map = renderPlotly({

    p = plot_ly(
      data = map_df,
      type = "choropleth",
      locations = ~country_iso3,
      locationmode = "ISO-3",
      z = ~density,
      key = ~country_iso3,
      source = "world",
      text = ~paste0(
        country_name,
        "<br>Studies: ", scales::comma(n_studies),
        "<br>Annual studies per million: ",
        round(density, 2)
      ),
      hoverinfo = "text",
      colorscale = "Viridis"
    ) |>
      layout(
        geo = list(
          showframe = FALSE,
          showcoastlines = FALSE,
          projection = list(type = "natural earth")
        )
      )

    event_register(p, "plotly_click")
  })


  # Detect country clicks
  observeEvent(
    event_data(
      "plotly_click",
      source = "world",
      priority = "event"
    ),
    {
      clicked = event_data(
        "plotly_click",
        source = "world"
      )

      req(nrow(clicked) > 0)

      code = if ("key" %in% names(clicked)) {
        as.character(clicked$key[1])
      } else if ("location" %in% names(clicked)) {
        as.character(clicked$location[1])
      } else {
        NULL
      }

      req(
        !is.null(code),
        code %in% map_df$country_iso3
      )

      selected_country(code)
    }
  )


  # Clear disease when selecting a new country
  observeEvent(
    selected_country(),
    {
      selected_disease(NULL)
    },
    ignoreInit = TRUE
  )


  # Country heading
  output$country_title = renderText({

    country_name = countrycode(
      selected_country(),
      "iso3c",
      "country.name"
    )

    paste("Disease research profile:", country_name)
  })


  # ---------------------------------------------------
  # B. CLICKABLE DISEASE BAR CHART
  # ---------------------------------------------------

  output$disease_plot = renderPlotly({

    d = country_diseases |>
      filter(country_iso3 == selected_country()) |>
      arrange(pct_studies) |>
      mutate(
        disease_label = factor(
          disease_category,
          levels = disease_category
        )
      )

    validate(
      need(nrow(d) > 0, "No classified studies available")
    )

    p = plot_ly(
      data = d,
      x = ~pct_studies,
      y = ~disease_label,
      key = ~disease_category,
      source = "disease",
      type = "bar",
      orientation = "h",
      text = ~paste0(
        round(pct_studies, 1), "%",
        "<br>", scales::comma(n_category),
        " studies",
        "<br>Click to see studies"
      ),
      hoverinfo = "text"
    ) |>
      layout(
        xaxis = list(
          title = "% of registered studies",
          range = c(0, 100)
        ),
        yaxis = list(
          title = "",
          automargin = TRUE
        ),
        margin = list(l = 260, r = 20)
      )

    event_register(p, "plotly_click")
  })


  # Detect disease category clicks
  observeEvent(
    event_data(
      "plotly_click",
      source = "disease",
      priority = "event"
    ),
    {
      clicked = event_data(
        "plotly_click",
        source = "disease"
      )

      req(nrow(clicked) > 0)

      disease = if ("key" %in% names(clicked)) {
        as.character(clicked$key[1])
      } else if ("y" %in% names(clicked)) {
        as.character(clicked$y[1])
      } else {
        NULL
      }

      available = country_diseases |>
        filter(country_iso3 == selected_country()) |>
        pull(disease_category)

      req(
        !is.null(disease),
        disease %in% available
      )

      selected_disease(disease)
    }
  )


  # ---------------------------------------------------
  # C. GET INDIVIDUAL STUDIES
  # ---------------------------------------------------

  # Only retrieve details for selected country/disease
  study_details = reactive({

    req(selected_country(), selected_disease())

    matching_ids = study_country_map |>
      filter(country_iso3 == selected_country()) |>
      semi_join(
        study_diseases |>
          filter(
            disease_category == selected_disease()
          ),
        by = "nct_id"
      ) |>
      distinct(nct_id)

    matching_ids |>
      left_join(
        trials_df |>
          select(
            nct_id,
            brief_title,
            study_type,
            start_date,
            completion_date,
            overall_status
          ),
        by = "nct_id",
        relationship = "many-to-one"
      ) |>
      mutate(
        start_date = as.Date(start_date),
        completion_date = as.Date(completion_date),
        duration_months = if_else(
          !is.na(start_date) &
            !is.na(completion_date) &
            completion_date >= start_date,
          round(
            as.numeric(
              completion_date - start_date
            ) / 30.44,
            1
          ),
          NA_real_
        )
      )
  })


  # ---------------------------------------------------
  # D. STUDY TABLE HEADING
  # ---------------------------------------------------

  output$studies_heading = renderText({

    if (is.null(selected_disease())) {
      return(
        "Click a disease category to view individual studies"
      )
    }

    country_name = countrycode(
      selected_country(),
      "iso3c",
      "country.name"
    )

    paste0(
      "Studies in ", country_name,
      " — ", selected_disease(),
      " (", scales::comma(nrow(study_details())),
      " studies)"
    )
  })


  # ---------------------------------------------------
  # E. SEARCHABLE STUDY TABLE
  # ---------------------------------------------------

  output$studies_table = DT::renderDT({

    req(selected_disease())

    d = study_details() |>
      arrange(desc(start_date)) |>
      transmute(
        `NCT ID` = nct_id,
        `Study title` = coalesce(
          brief_title, "Title unavailable"
        ),
        `Study type` = study_type,
        `Start date` = as.character(start_date),
        `Completion date` = as.character(completion_date),
        `Reported interval (months)` = duration_months,
        `Status` = overall_status
      )

    # Clickable study titles
    d$`Study title` = paste0(
      '<a href="https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/',
      d$`NCT ID`,
      '" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">',
      htmltools::htmlEscape(d$`Study title`),
      '</a>'
    )

    DT::datatable(
      d,
      rownames = FALSE,
      filter = "top",
      escape = which(names(d) != "Study title"),
      options = list(
        pageLength = 10,
        lengthMenu = c(10, 25, 50),
        scrollX = TRUE
      )
    )

  }, server = TRUE)

}


# =====================================================
# 4. LAUNCH APP
# =====================================================

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)

```

```{r}
country_disease |>
  filter(
    disease_category == "neoplasms",
    n_total >= 100
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(pct_studies)) |>
  slice_head(n = 20) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = pct_studies,
    y = reorder(country, pct_studies)
  )) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Countries With the Highest Share of Cancer Research",
    subtitle = "Countries with at least 100 registered studies",
    x = "Percentage of studies investigating neoplasms",
    y = "Country"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
